description: Canonical inventory of the duplicated CI-critical explicit test target groups used by the current CI hardening slice.

chosen_for: easy consumption from workflow shell steps via python3
stable, explicit structure for grouped test targets

glossary.backend_contract: Focused backend contract, alert-route, session-service, and split alert/MCP contract suites used by the protected CI lane.
glossary.mcp_fastapi_parity: FastAPI-versus-MCP boundary and parity suites over the shared alert and incident read seam.
glossary.frontend_contract: Bridge and frontend contract suites used by the CI-facing frontend contract lane.
glossary.weekly_slow_media: Real-media and detector-integration suites reserved for the weekly slow lane.
glossary.weekly_api_stream_deep: Heavier api_stream and HTTP/HLS regression suites reserved for the weekly deep-validation lane.
glossary.weekly_lifecycle: Lifecycle-heavy session runner and persistence suites reserved for the weekly lifecycle lane.

notes: Group names stay short and stable for workflow, policy, and docs consumers.
Weekly-heavy targets stay as top-level groups so consumers do not need nested manifest knowledge.

ownership_notes: This manifest covers only duplicated CI-critical explicit test target groups.
It stays narrower than the full CI configuration surface.
The current ci.yml inventory does not need additional selector groups: broad shared contract consumers are already manifest-backed, while the remaining smoke path stays intentionally inline.

excluded_target_categories: full fast-lane backend selectors such as pytest -m filters
lint, typecheck, packaging, and audit jobs

ci_yml_selector_inventory.status: complete for current ci.yml workflow consumers
notes: test-and-build already resolves the broad shared backend and frontend contract consumers from stable manifest groups.
integration-smoke remains a deliberate inline one-off path and does not justify a reusable selector group.
This inventory is the full current surface for the future CI path-existence self-check.
It intentionally includes the one inline smoke-path exception and the narrower policy-only test paths from check_main_pr_consistency.py.

excluded_path_categories: glob-like selectors if they appear later
notes: The existence self-check is a narrow structural guard for CI-owned test paths.
It should not expand into a general repo linter or source-path validator.

workflow_to_manifest: the shared reader-backed contract groups in ci.yml test-and-build must match the protected alignment group set
policy_to_workflow: manifest groups consumed by manifest-backed ContractGate entries in check_main_pr_consistency.py must match the shared reader-backed contract groups in ci.yml test-and-build
docs_to_manifest: docs/testing-and-validation.md must mention every stable manifest group and the core manifest ownership references
docs/README.md must mention every stable manifest group and the core manifest ownership references
docs/contracts.md must mention every stable manifest group and the core manifest ownership references
notes: This inventory records the exact alignment contract currently enforced by check_ci_target_drift.py.
It is intentionally narrower than a general docs-correctness review and narrower than path-existence validation.
Alignment is intentionally anchored to the protected shared contract lane in ci.yml and the manifest-backed policy groups in check_main_pr_consistency.py.
Weekly-only groups, the inline integration smoke path, and broader workflow behavior should not be forced into the same equality rule.
